core_obligations: Replace R by Z (closed immersion into X x_Z Y); present F as a quotient of a finitely presented module.
Write X = lim X_i and Y = lim Y_j with finitely presented transitions; descend F and the resolution property to some X_i x Y_j.
Apply the noetherian card at the descended level and pull back.
proof_roadmap: Reduce and descend, then pull back the base-case surjection.
difficulty_reason: Limit approximation argument reducing to the noetherian card; fully displayed despite the stylistic aside.
